title: Run prioritized jobs with retries and a shallow loop
task: In package `jobs`, run a batch of jobs in priority order (highest first, ties by submission order): each job has a name, a priority, and a `Run() error`; a job that fails is retried up to two more times, and a job marked cancelled is skipped. Return a report of what succeeded, what failed after all retries, and what was skipped. I would like the loop to stay shallow enough to read in one glance. Test a job that succeeds on its third try, one that never succeeds, and a cancelled one.
